_note: Rohan's ownership and decision footprint over 5 years. Each project has decision drivers, key threads, and people involved — used to drive realistic email/meeting/RFC generation.

projects.title: Events Service datastore selection — Postgres vs MongoDB vs ClickHouse
projects.status: decided — Postgres, with ClickHouse as future-Q3 contingency
projects.summary: Sept 2023 RFC. Rohan argued against MongoDB (relational queries to users/subscriptions, Mongo migration scars on billing). ClickHouse considered but rejected as premature given event volume. Final decision in Sept 14 architecture review. Revisit trigger: 50M events/day.
projects.decision: Postgres. ClickHouse re-evaluation gated on >50M events/day.

projects.title: Rate limiter rewrite (v1 token-bucket → v2 leaky-bucket)
projects.summary: May 2024 outage exposed race condition in v1 Redis token-bucket under burst traffic. Rohan pushed back on full rewrite, ended up with leaky-bucket variant. Ankur Bose did most implementation under Rohan's review. Known limitation: per-tenant limits not synced across regions (tech debt flagged by Maya).
projects.decision: Leaky-bucket impl in ratelimit-v2 repo. Cross-region sync deferred.

projects.title: SSO architecture — SAML + OIDC support
projects.summary: Customer-driven (Hooli, Umbrella, Globex). Built OIDC-first because of cleaner spec and library quality; SAML added under sustained enterprise demand. Yelena Petrov primary owner; Rohan reviewed. Sasha (Security) joint sign-off.
projects.decision: OIDC-first; SAML as fallback. JIT provisioning gated on customer SCIM support.

projects.title: API gateway migration — Kong → in-house Envoy-based
projects.summary: Kong's licensing model + plugin pain motivated move to Envoy with thin Go control plane. Rohan was reluctant initially — proposed staying on Kong with custom plugins — overruled by ecosystem complexity. Drove migration in 3 phases. Resulted in 30% latency reduction at p99.
projects.decision: Envoy with Go control plane. Kong fully retired by 2025-Q2.

projects.title: Incident: 2024-05-14 burst-traffic outage
projects.summary: Hooli batch-job kicked off ~3x normal request volume at 14:22 UTC. v1 rate limiter race condition let traffic through, overwhelming events service. 47 minutes degraded, 12 minutes full outage. Trigger for rate-limiter-v2 project.
projects.decision: Action items: rate-limiter-v2, per-tenant alerting, customer-traffic-pattern review.

projects.title: Incident: 2025-05-22 API rate-limit cascade affecting Hooli
projects.summary: Misconfigured per-tenant limit on Hooli's recently-expanded usage tripped global circuit breaker. Affected 9% of API traffic for 38 minutes. Rohan + Mei coordinated; Priya managed customer comms. SLA credit issued. Resulted in better tenant-isolation work.
projects.decision: Tenant isolation hardened; alerting on limit-derived events added.

projects.title: Postgres multi-region read replicas
projects.summary: Added read replicas in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Priya's EMEA accounts (Macrohard) drove this.

projects.title: Internal SDK standardization (Python + TS)
projects.summary: Unified the auth + retry + telemetry behavior across internal services. Bryan Okonkwo primary; Rohan reviewer.

projects.title: SCIM 2.0 provisioning support
projects.summary: Built atop SSO work. Driven by enterprise renewals (Globex, Hooli).

projects.title: ClickHouse spike for events service
projects.summary: Tarun ran 3-week spike. Volume not yet at trigger threshold (45M/day vs 50M trigger). Decision: defer. Document spike findings for next year.

projects.title: Proposed GraphQL public gateway (KILLED)
projects.summary: PM (Diego) proposed exposing GraphQL gateway externally for partner integrations. Rohan killed it after RFC review — REST already mature, GraphQL added auth-N/Z and N+1 risk for marginal benefit. Lives in Rohan's 'graveyard' doc.

projects.title: Proposed split of Billing service into 4 microservices (KILLED)
projects.summary: Daniel Heath proposed splitting Billing. Rohan pushed back: 'we have one team, we don't need four services.' Compromise: extracted only Invoice generation as a worker.

projects.title: Engineering hiring — System Design loop redesign
